_comment: Lunar-Charged enabler (Moonsign). Birgitta: Discharge tiap 2s selama 20s (172.8% ATK lv10) + A1 hit 65% ATK Lunar-Charged tiap Discharge kalau ada thundercloud (hit skill3 dari talentOverrides). Reaksi Lunar-Charged tick ~2s dihitung level tim (rotation) atau react:lunarCharged di preset.

self.description: Ineffa Moonsign Benediction (ke diri sendiri): Base DMG Lunar-Charged +0.7% per 100 ATK (max 14%).
Ineffa C1 (ke diri sendiri): Lunar-Charged DMG +2.5% per 100 ATK (max 50%) selama shield 20s.
Ineffa A4 (butuh Q): EM +6% ATK selama 20s.

_actions_comment: react:lunarCharged = proc reaksi yang DIPICU Birgitta (tiap Discharge nge-apply Electro ke aura Hydro) — in-game 10/20s. Dikreditkan ke Ineffa seperti DPS meter.
